title: A CertificateVerify message
request: The Certificate message whose hash this signature covers
response: `0f`, a uint24 length, a uint16 SignatureScheme, a uint16 signature length, and the signature.
note: The signature is over content the message does not contain: 64 spaces, a context string, a zero byte and the transcript hash up to and including Certificate.

request_fields.value: 0 — a server's Certificate always carries an empty context
a DER X.509 certificate — entry 0 is the end-entity certificate, and each later entry certifies the one before it
0 — every entry carries its own extensions block, new in TLS 1.3

response_fields.value: over 64 spaces, "TLS 1.3, server CertificateVerify", a zero byte and Transcript-Hash(ClientHello..Certificate) — 3045022100abea12… (71 bytes)

title: The bytes that are signed
request:
20 20 20 ... 20                                   (64 bytes)
"TLS 1.3, server CertificateVerify"               (33 bytes)
00                                                (1 byte)
Transcript-Hash(ClientHello .. Certificate)        (32 or 48 bytes)
response: 130 bytes under SHA-256, or 146 under SHA-384. That string is hashed by the signature algorithm — except for Ed25519, which signs it directly.
note: Every element earns its place: the spaces defeat cross-protocol replay, the string separates client from server, the zero byte stops the string running into the hash.
